title: Real Tauri screenshot capture and accurate P01 Help/Wiki sources
summary: T10 native Windows screenshot candidate is authentic but still pending independent visual acceptance; fix checkout-to-build SHA provenance (both recorded), capture-script CI change gate, nonnumeric Ctrl shortcut crash, and inaccurate M01 UI/Help/Wiki workflow claims. No PNG accepted or user-facing release. M16/M17/M18 Help and Wiki now document tested read-only/native-only subsets instead of invented navigation, F1 Help and incident-ID flows. Windows #45004462969 exposed malformed PowerShell source (ParserError), fixed from original GitHub source and now guarded by PowerShell ParseFile CI before Rust build. Windows #45005079893 passed real native screenshot capture, parser, 32 native tests and cold boot. PNG is an unreviewed candidate only; T10 stays IN_PROGRESS. Independent image audit rejected #45005079893's white scrollbar and incomplete first viewport; add dark native scroll and four native follow-up captures with hash/blank rejection. Visual acceptance remains pending.
migration_notes: No user data migration. Read-only shell and CI/provenance changes only.
